responsibility: Implements SSA-based mathematical simplification passes that recognize profitable arithmetic identities beyond simple folding. Its main responsibilities are reciprocal CSE for repeated divisions, widening multiply/add/subtract formation, fused multiply-add conversion, paired div/mod combination into divmod-style calls, and related overflow-aware arithmetic rewrites performed during dominance walks over GIMPLE, while collecting pass statistics and requesting CFG cleanup when transforms affect control flow or EH.
same_name_distinction: Implements the tree-SSA math optimization passes themselves, including reciprocal CSE, widening multiply/add formation, FMA conversion, and div/mod combination during dominance walks. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-math-opts.h, it is not the narrow shared interface file exposing only helper declarations such as powi_as_mults.
